/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import json, hashlib, os
R='/root/worktrees/send-c1b/'
d=json.load(open(R+'docs/implementation/c2a-r29/starting-hashes.json'))
print(type(d).__name__, list(d)[:5] if isinstance(d,dict) else d[:2])
files = d.get('files', d) if isinstance(d,dict) else d
if isinstance(files, dict):
    items = files.items()
else:
    items = [(f['path'], f['sha256']) for f in files]
items = dict(items)
print(len(items), 'placement', str(items.get('backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py'))[:12])
T='backend/dealroom_sign/tests/'
snap={k:v for k,v in items.items() if k.startswith(T)}
changed=[k for k,v in snap.items() if not os.path.exists(R+k) or hashlib.sha256(open(R+k,'rb').read()).hexdigest()!=(v if isinstance(v,str) else v.get('sha256'))]
print('test files in snapshot', len(snap), 'changed/deleted', changed[:10], len(changed))
disk=[]
for root,ds,fs in os.walk(R+T):
    ds[:] = [x for x in ds if x!='__pycache__']
    for f in fs: disk.append(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root,f),R))
new=sorted(set(disk)-set(snap))
print('new', len(new)); print([n for n in new if 'fixtures/r29/' not in n]); print(len([n for n in new if 'fixtures/r29/' in n]),'fixtures/r29')
other=[k for k,v in items.items() if not k.startswith('docs/') and not k.startswith(T) and os.path.exists(R+k) and hashlib.sha256(open(R+k,'rb').read()).hexdigest()!=(v if isinstance(v,str) else v.get('sha256'))]
print('non-docs non-test changed', other)
pyc=[os.path.join(r,f) for r,ds,fs in os.walk(R+'backend') for f in fs if f.endswith('.pyc') and '__pycache__' not in r]
print('stray pyc', pyc)
EOF
